analysis_type: High-precision numerical certification of x-b4 sign and conservative native arctangent prediction envelopes over explicitly defined parameter ellipsoids and continuous held-out intervals; no refitting or probability-region claim

region_rule.center: Each frozen native parameter vector b1,b2,b3,b4 exactly as stored; no refitting or center update
region_rule.matrix: The corresponding frozen four-by-four local covariance matrix is used only to define an ellipsoid and is not interpreted as posterior or confidence covariance
region_rule.ellipsoid: E={theta:(theta-center)^T C^(-1)(theta-center) <= radius^2}; require symmetric positive-definite C by high-precision Cholesky
region_rule.radius_scope: Radius four is a frozen arithmetic choice, not a confidence level, probability coverage, optimized bound or calibrated uncertainty region
region_rule.support_identity: For any vector g, the maximum of g^T(theta-center) over E is radius*sqrt(g^T C g)
region_rule.independent_relaxation: Independent linear-term, argument and arctangent relaxations may be loose but must remain conservative

singularity_rule.continuous_interval: Both bounds are affine in x, so their extrema occur at endpoints
singularity_rule.negative_certificate: Require both outward-rounded endpoint d_max values to be strictly negative
singularity_rule.positive_certificate: Require both outward-rounded endpoint d_min values to be strictly positive
singularity_rule.failure: If neither sign can be certified, mark the fold unavailable and do not generate finite prediction or residual bounds
singularity_rule.critical_radius: When both endpoint centers have the same sign, critical radius is min(abs(d_hat_left)/sqrt(C_b4b4),abs(d_hat_right)/sqrt(C_b4b4)); strict sign requires radius < critical value
singularity_rule.negative_control: For every fold, verify that half the analytic critical radius is accepted and the exact critical radius is rejected
singularity_rule.scope: The certificate applies only to the defined ellipsoid and closed interval, not all parameters, all x or physical reality

prediction_rule.native_model: f=b1-b2*x-(1/pi)*arctan(b3/(x-b4)); use the original arctangent function, not a Taylor approximation
prediction_rule.linear_term: Compute A_min and A_max from b1_min,b1_max,b2_min,b2_max and x, evaluating both candidates to respect the sign of x
prediction_rule.argument_bounds: Compute b3_min and b3_max from the ellipsoid support and evaluate all four ratios of b3_min,b3_max with d_min,d_max to obtain z_min and z_max conservatively
prediction_rule.arctangent_bounds: Use atan(z_min) and atan(z_max) because arctangent is increasing
prediction_rule.prediction_envelope: Use f_min=A_min-atan(z_max)/pi and f_max=A_max-atan(z_min)/pi; independent relaxations may be loose but remain conservative
prediction_rule.residual_upper_bound: For each observed y, use max(abs(y-f_min),abs(y-f_max)) conditional on the defined ellipsoid and certified nonzero sign
prediction_rule.center_consistency: Require every frozen center prediction to lie inside its available envelope and actual residual not to exceed its upper bound; this is arithmetic consistency, not external validation or probability coverage
prediction_rule.width_audit: Report argument ranges, envelope widths and residual upper bounds so formally valid but wide bounds cannot be called high information

numerical_rule.engine: mpmath with 80 decimal digits and exact decimal conversion of stored input values
numerical_rule.outward_relative_margin: Apply a relative margin of 1e-24 before conversion to binary floats, then use nextafter in the outward direction for every certified lower and upper value
numerical_rule.certificate_class: High-precision numerical interval certificate, not exact rational algebra
numerical_rule.positive_definite_check: Fail rather than generate bounds if the covariance matrix is not symmetric positive definite
numerical_rule.failure_preservation: Non-finite values, failed Cholesky, sign crossings, exact critical radii and unavailable envelopes are retained explicitly

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生Roszman1原生椭球奇异界_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, changed centers, changed covariance matrices, changed folds or post-hoc radius selection
No Taylor-model substitution for the native arctangent prediction envelope
No finite prediction or residual bound when x-b4 sign cannot be certified over the full ellipsoid and continuous interval
No probability, confidence, posterior, calibrated-coverage, optimal-radius or physical-endogeneity claim
No use of center-prediction containment or actual-residual coverage as independent scientific validation
No exact rational-certificate claim for the high-precision numerical intervals
No hiding of sign crossings, unavailable folds, wide envelopes or numerical failures
